programme_scope: Introductory child-protection and safeguarding learning pathway, not a qualifying professional degree or deployment licence
curriculum_reason: Retain foundational recognition, family support and permanency. Eight titles fit the owner-requested five-to-ten range. Standards do not prescribe an academy course count or confer accreditation.
